expected: table rows are supplied as structured scan rows

label: Attendance XLSX date and work-hour formatting
prompt: 最近有没缺勤的人？工时最长和最短分别是谁？

first/last punch serial timestamps are normalized to HH:MM
blank punch columns stay aligned with work-hour columns
